messages:
evan: hi all, ran the node starter and my first call returns 403 with 'billing_required'. followed steps in README but didn't see any clear note about needing a card to enable the API.
lina_dev: can you paste the exact error body?
evan: sure — minimal repro below. i set REDWOOD_API_KEY and ran it:
```js
const { Redwood } = require('@redwood/inference');
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });
await client.generate({ model: 'gpt-open-1', prompt: 'hello' });
```
response body: {"error":"403","reason":"billing_required","message":"add_billing_to_activate"}
paul_sdk: thanks. we shipped a gate that blocks generate for new orgs without billing to prevent abuse. however the SDK currently surfaces the raw reason which is terse. we should map it to a friendlier error and docs link.
support_bot: note — onboarding-gate v2 active. see internal post: rollout/2026-03-01 on-call note.
evan: is there any way to detect this before making a generate call? would be great if the sample preflight checks org status.
paul_sdk: yep — we have GET /orgs/:id/status but it's not in quickstart. i'll add a simple preflight that calls it and prints next steps if billing_required. filing DEVEX-1215 to update starter and SDK error text.
ops: small ask from infra: make the error surface only one stable code (e.g., OnboardingBlocked) so client libraries can pattern-match instead of parsing strings.
lina_dev: agree. i'll add a one-line guard in the sample and in the README. evan — i'll DM a sandbox token you can use while we publish the change.
evan: awesome, thanks everyone. saved me an hour. :)
